sentences.en: From The New York Times, I'm Rachel Abrams, and this is The Daily.
sentences.zh: 来自《纽约时报》，我是蕾切尔·艾布拉姆斯，这是《每日新闻》。

sentences.en: About a month into the war with Iran, back when gas was at $3.99 a gallon, Daily producer
sentences.zh: 在与伊朗的战争大约开始一个月后，当时油价为每加仑3.99美元，《每日新闻》制作人

sentences.en: Anna Foley, headed to Florida to talk to a gas station owner about how prices at the pump were feeling both for him and his customers.
sentences.zh: 安娜·福利前往佛罗伦萨，与一位加油站老板探讨油价飙升对他和他的顾客意味着什么。

sentences.en: I would love for this to be over next week and I go back to $2.79 a gallon.
sentences.zh: 我希望这一切能在下周结束，我能回到每加仑2.79美元。

sentences.en: That'd be awesome.
sentences.zh: 那就太棒了。

sentences.en: I hope beyond hope that it is temporary and it does not last long.
sentences.zh: 我极其希望这只是暂时的，不会持续太久。

sentences.en: But yeah, I do worry about the longevity of high prices.
sentences.zh: 但说实话，我确实担心高油价会持续多久。

sentences.en: That was back in March.
sentences.zh: 那是今年三月的事。

sentences.en: But recently, and somewhat unexpectedly, that gas station owner, Cam Judy, reached out to us again.
sentences.zh: 但最近，而且有些出人意料的是，那位加油站老板卡姆·朱迪又联系了我们。

sentences.en: Hello.
sentences.zh: 你好。

sentences.en: Hey, Cam.
sentences.zh: 嘿，卡姆。

sentences.en: Hey, Anna.
sentences.zh: 嘿，安娜。

sentences.en: How you doing?
sentences.zh: 近来可好？

sentences.en: He had an update.
sentences.zh: 他带来了最新消息。

sentences.en: So, a few days ago, you texted me because of this kind of wild thing you were seeing happen at your pumps.
sentences.zh: 所以，几天前你给我发信息，是因为你发现加油站发生了一件挺疯狂的事。

sentences.en: So I just want to know what happened.
sentences.zh: 所以我只想知道发生了什么。

sentences.en: Tell me the story.
sentences.zh: 跟我讲讲吧。

sentences.en: Yeah, so I checked the gas prices.
sentences.zh: 对，我查了油价。

sentences.en: I believe it was Wednesday.
sentences.zh: 我记得是星期三。

sentences.en: Wednesday, I was working until around 3 o'clock in the afternoon, just checking the prices and see what was going on and everything seemed normal.
sentences.zh: 星期三那天我工作到下午3点左右，刚好查了一下油价，看看情况怎么样，一切似乎都挺正常的。

sentences.en: Where were you checking them?
sentences.zh: 你在哪里查的？

sentences.en: I was checking them on GasBuddy, the different gas stations, see what everybody was priced at.
sentences.zh: 我在 GasBuddy 上查的，看看各个加油站的价格，大家的定价都是多少。

sentences.en: I was sitting at $3.99 a gallon for regular gas.
sentences.zh: 我的普通汽油价格是每加仑3.99美元。

sentences.en: And the next day, I opened the gas station and I was talking to my beer distributor and he was like, what's your gas at, Cam?
sentences.zh: 结果第二天我开店时，正跟我的啤酒经销商聊天，他问我，卡姆，你这油价多少钱？

sentences.en: And I said, I'm still at $3.99.
sentences.zh: 我说，我还是3.99美元。

sentences.en: And he's like, wow, all the other gas stations I passed by on the way in here all went to
sentences.zh: 他说，哇，我这一路开过来，路过的所有加油站都在

sentences.en: $4.19 this morning.
sentences.zh: 今天早上涨到了4.19美元。

sentences.en: And I was like, there's no way.
sentences.zh: 我说，这不可能。

sentences.en: There's no way.
sentences.zh: 绝对不可能。

sentences.en: It was $3.99 yesterday.
sentences.zh: 昨天还是3.99美元呢。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: That's a 20 cent jump in price overnight.
sentences.zh: 一夜之间价格跳涨了20美分。

sentences.en: That's pretty crazy.
sentences.zh: 这挺疯狂的。

sentences.en: It's pretty shocking.
sentences.zh: 挺让人震惊的。

sentences.en: And I didn't believe them until I checked the gas stations in and around me.
sentences.zh: 我一开始还不信，直到我查了我周围的加油站。

sentences.en: And sure enough, every single one of them was at $4.19 for regular gasoline.
sentences.zh: 果不其然，每一家的普通汽油都是4.19美元。

sentences.en: I said, wow, I guess I really need to, as much as I don't want to, I got to go up 20 cents a gallon.
sentences.zh: 我说，好吧，虽然我一万个不愿意，但我也得每加仑涨20美分了。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是啊。

sentences.en: Did customers notice?
sentences.zh: 顾客注意到了吗？

sentences.en: And what did they say to you?
sentences.zh: 他们对你说了什么？

sentences.en: Oh, yeah.
sentences.zh: 哦，当然。

sentences.en: Oh, yeah.
sentences.zh: 哦，肯定的。

sentences.en: I mean, the one phrase out of everybody's mouths were just, what's going on with these gas prices?
sentences.zh: 我是说，每个人嘴里蹦出来的一句话都是，这油价到底是怎么回事？

sentences.en: When you guys came down here last time, of course, the conflict over in the Middle East area had just started.
sentences.zh: 当你们上次来这里的时候，中东地区的冲突当然才刚刚爆发。

sentences.en: It was very prominent in the news.
sentences.zh: 这在新闻里非常显眼。

sentences.en: Everybody was talking about it.
sentences.zh: 每个人都在讨论。

sentences.en: And it was kind of expected, I think, back then.
sentences.zh: 我想当时大家或多或少都有所预期。

sentences.en: Okay, we got a war going on.
sentences.zh: 好吧，我们有仗要打。

sentences.en: There's conflict going on.
sentences.zh: 有冲突正在发生。

sentences.en: Yeah, we're going to see a big jump in gas prices.
sentences.zh: 好吧，油价肯定会大幅飙升。

sentences.en: But the war and the conflict over there hasn't really been talked much about lately.
sentences.zh: 但那边的战争和冲突最近已经没怎么被讨论了。

sentences.en: There's other stuff going on in the news that people are talking about.
sentences.zh: 新闻里有别的事情，大家都在讨论别的。

sentences.en: People kind of forgot.
sentences.zh: 人们有点淡忘了。

sentences.en: And that's kind of the hardest part for me is I just, I don't have an answer.
sentences.zh: 对我和我而言最难的是，我根本找不到答案。

sentences.en: What specifically caused a 20 cent increase in a period of 24 hours?
sentences.zh: 到底是什么原因导致油价在24小时内上涨了20美分？

sentences.en: I just wish, not even as a business owner, as a regular average Joe citizen, I would like to know why.
sentences.zh: 我只希望，甚至不是作为一个企业主，而是作为一个普通的老百姓，我想知道为什么。

sentences.en: And I think a lot of my customers would also like to know why.
sentences.zh: 我想我的很多顾客也想知道为什么。

sentences.en: So today on the show, we attempt to answer Cam's question.
sentences.zh: 所以今天的节目中，我们试图解答卡姆的问题。

sentences.en: What is driving rising oil prices?
sentences.zh: 是什么在推高油价？

sentences.en: I speak with my colleague Vivian Neerheim about the expanding Iran war and why its ripple effects are being felt at pumps around the world.
sentences.zh: 我与同事维维安·尼尔海姆进行了交谈，讨论不断扩大的伊朗战争以及为什么世界各地的加油站都能感受到其连锁反应。

sentences.en: It's Thursday, September 17th.
sentences.zh: 今天是9月17日，星期四。

sentences.en: Vivian, welcome back to the show.
sentences.zh: 维维安，欢迎回到节目。

sentences.en: Thanks for having me.
sentences.zh: 谢谢邀请我。

sentences.en: So we here at The Daily have been in touch with this gas station owner in Florida, who I am sure is not the only person who's sort of confused by what he's seeing right now.
sentences.zh: 我们在《每日新闻》的团队最近联系了佛罗里达州的那位加油站老板，我确信他绝对不是唯一一个对眼前的景象感到困惑的人。

sentences.en: He and many of us understand that this stranglehold on the Strait of Hormuz has sent gas prices soaring.
sentences.zh: 他和我们许多人都明白，对霍尔木兹海峡的扼制已经让油价飙升。

sentences.en: Like, we all get that by this point in the war.
sentences.zh: 就像，打到这个阶段大家心里都清楚这一点。

sentences.en: But the U.S.
sentences.zh: 但美国

sentences.en: and Iran have been in a stalemate for months now.
sentences.zh: 和伊朗已经僵持了好几个月了。

sentences.en: So we're turning to you to explain to us what has happened on the ground that can help explain this sudden surge in prices.
sentences.zh: 所以我们请你来向我们解释一下，地面上究竟发生了什么，能帮助解释这突如其来的价格飙升。

sentences.en: Yeah, so I'm talking to you from Riyadh, Saudi Arabia.
sentences.zh: 好的，我现在在沙特阿拉伯的利雅得向你汇报。

sentences.en: And Saudi Arabia has for a long time been the world's largest exporter of oil.
sentences.zh: 沙特阿拉伯长期以来一直是世界上最大的石油出口国。

sentences.en: You know, if you want to move oil prices, you look to Saudi Arabia.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，如果你想左右油价，你就得看沙特阿拉伯。

sentences.en: And up until this point, Saudi Arabia has largely been on the sidelines of this war.
sentences.zh: 直到目前为止，沙特阿拉伯在这场战争中基本上都处于作壁上观的状态。

sentences.en: Yes, it was getting attacked.
sentences.zh: 是的，它遭到了袭击。

sentences.en: Yes, things were quite concerning.
sentences.zh: 是的，情况相当令人担忧。

sentences.en: But at the same time, it wasn't getting hit as hard as some of the states east of the
sentences.zh: 但与此同时，它并没有受到像东部某些国家那样猛烈的打击，比如

sentences.en: Persian Gulf, like the United Arab Emirates, Qatar, Kuwait, Bahrain.
sentences.zh: 波斯湾沿岸的国家，如阿拉伯联合酋长国、卡塔尔、科威特、巴林。

sentences.en: You know, I and a lot of other people were kind of sitting here wondering why, to be honeSt.
sentences.zh: 老实说，我和许多其他人当时都坐在这里纳闷，这是为什么呢？

sentences.en: Why was Iran targeting all of these other states and kind of easing up a bit on Saudi Arabia?
sentences.zh: 为什么伊朗要把目标对准所有这些别的国家，却对沙特阿拉伯稍微手下留情了呢？

sentences.en: In the past few weeks, all of that has changed.
sentences.zh: 但在过去几周里，这一切都变了。

sentences.en: Essentially, it's become very clear that one of the reasons that this wasn't happening, that the country wasn't being attacked as heavily as the other Gulf states,
sentences.zh: 本质上，有一点变得非常清晰，即为什么之前没有发生这种情况，为什么这个国家没有像其他海湾国家那样遭到猛烈攻击，

sentences.en: is that Iran was kind of holding this card and waiting to play it.
sentences.zh: 是因为伊朗手里一直捏着这张牌，在等着打出来。

sentences.en: And that that is what has happened now, essentially.
sentences.zh: 而这基本上就是现在所发生的事情。

sentences.en: Now they've decided to play that card.
sentences.zh: 现在他们决定打出这张牌了。

sentences.en: And what is that card, Vivian?
sentences.zh: 维维安，那到底是什么牌？

sentences.en: Just unspool that for us.
sentences.zh: 给我们详细讲讲吧。

sentences.en: So Saudi Arabia, it's just on the other side of the Gulf from Iran.
sentences.zh: 所以沙特阿拉伯，它就在海湾的另一侧，与伊朗隔海相望。

sentences.en: And they managed to find a workaround during the Iran war because of their geography, because of their history, to get their oil out from another exit point.
sentences.zh: 在伊朗战争期间，由于他们的地理位置和历史原因，他们设法找到了一种变通办法，将石油从另一个出口运输出去。

sentences.en: So while the Strait of Hormuz, which is on sort of the eastern side of Saudi Arabia, close to Iran, was essentially choked off,
sentences.zh: 所以，当位于沙特阿拉伯东侧、靠近伊朗的霍尔木兹海峡基本上被掐断时，

sentences.en: Saudi Arabia had built a long time ago this gigantic oil pipeline that stretches all the way across the kingdom.
sentences.zh: 沙特阿拉伯很久以前就修建了一条横跨整个王国的巨大输油管道。

sentences.en: And this had just been built as a sort of eventuality.
sentences.zh: 这条管道当初修建只是为了防患于未然。

sentences.en: Maybe someday we'll need this.
sentences.zh: 也许有一天我们会需要它。

sentences.en: And it suddenly became the moment for this oil pipeline.
sentences.zh: 而现在突然成了这条输油管道的高光时刻。

sentences.en: They started pushing as much of their oil as they could over land through this pipeline to the Red Sea to get it out to their global customers that way.
sentences.zh: 他们开始通过这条陆上管道，将尽可能多的石油输送到红海，以此将石油运送给全球客户。

sentences.en: So they had this workaround that none of the other Gulf states had.
sentences.zh: 所以他们拥有其他海湾国家所没有的这种替代方案。

sentences.en: And as a result, the kingdom's supply of oil to global markets was much less affected than the other countries.
sentences.zh: 因此，该王国对全球市场的石油供应受到的影响，远比其他国家要小得多。

sentences.en: But all of that changed over the past few weeks, essentially, as Iran's ally in Yemen began focusing its attention on that route and essentially seeking to cut off that route.
sentences.zh: 但所有这一切在过去几周里发生了根本性的变化，因为伊朗在也门的盟友开始将注意力集中在那条线路上，并实质上试图切断该路线。

sentences.en: Okay, so fill in the specifics of what has actually happened.
sentences.zh: 好的，那么请补充一下实际发生的事情的具体细节。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: So the group that you really need to understand here is the Houthis, which are an Iranian ally in Yemen.
sentences.zh: 所以你在这里真正需要了解的组织是胡塞武装，他们是伊朗在也门的盟友。

sentences.en: So the Houthis started out as this kind of ragtag religious movement in northern Yemen.
sentences.zh: 胡塞武装最初只是也门北部的一支散漫的宗教运动力量。

sentences.en: And they became these increasingly important power players starting in 2014.
sentences.zh: 从2014年开始，他们逐渐成为越来越重要的权力角逐者。

sentences.en: In the aftermath of this really complicated, failed sort of Arab Spring transition in Yemen, the Houthis swept into Sana'a, the capital of Yemen, and they took it over.
sentences.zh: 在也门这场非常复杂且失败的“阿拉伯之春”过渡之后果中，胡塞武装长驱直入也门首都萨那，并将其占领。

sentences.en: They essentially routed the internationally recognized government of Yemen, pushed them out of the city,
sentences.zh: 他们基本上击溃了也门获得国际承认的政府，将其驱逐出该市，

sentences.en: and then continued to actually push them farther and farther south in Yemen.
sentences.zh: 然后继续将他们进一步向也门南部驱赶。

sentences.en: That set off this really brutal and grinding civil war in which Saudi Arabia intervened to pretty disastrous consequences in 2015.
sentences.zh: 这引发了一场非常残酷且旷日持久的内战，沙特阿拉伯于2015年进行了干预，结果却造成了灾难性的后果。

sentences.en: To fight the Houthis.
sentences.zh: 为了打击胡塞武装。

sentences.en: To fight the Houthis and to try to restore the internationally recognized government.
sentences.zh: 为了打击胡塞武装并试图恢复获得国际承认的政府。

sentences.en: So Saudi Arabia is Yemen's northern neighbor.
sentences.zh: 所以沙特阿拉伯是也门的北方邻国。

sentences.en: They have this long, porous border with Yemen.
sentences.zh: 他们与也门有着漫长而漏洞百出的边境线。

sentences.en: And they were essentially looking at the Houthis, this militia that's backed by Iran, taking over territory on their border and getting quite nervous.
sentences.zh: 他们看到胡塞武装这个由伊朗支持的民兵组织占领了他们边界上的领土，感到相当紧张。

sentences.en: So they began this disastrous bombing campaign in Yemen to try to back the government and to essentially push out the Houthis.
sentences.zh: 于是他们在也门发起了灾难性的轰炸行动，试图支持政府并彻底击退胡塞武装。

sentences.en: So those two sides were fighting really fiercely.
sentences.zh: 所以这两派进行了极其激烈的战斗。

sentences.en: It became this really kind of fragmented, complicated civil war.
sentences.zh: 这演变成了一场非常碎片化、复杂的内战。

sentences.en: And then it reached a sort of stalemate in 2022.
sentences.zh: 然后在2022年达成了某种僵局。

sentences.en: When a truce was signed, this was backed by the United Nations.
sentences.zh: 当时签署了一项停火协议，得到了联合国的支持。

sentences.en: And fighting had largely quieted down since then.
sentences.zh: 自那以后，战斗在很大程度上平息了。

sentences.en: But the Houthis were frustrated.
sentences.zh: 但胡塞武装感到沮丧。

sentences.en: They really wanted to reach some form of political agreement that would recognize their power in Yemen and that would give them access to oil resources,
sentences.zh: 他们真的很想达成某种政治协议，承认他们在也门的力量，并赋予他们获取石油资源的权利，

sentences.en: which they do not have right now because of the territory that they control.
sentences.zh: 由于他们目前控制的领土所限，他们现在并没有这些资源。

sentences.en: So they were under political pressure to do something.
sentences.zh: 因此他们面临着采取行动的政治压力。

sentences.en: And this was sort of the backdrop in which the Iran war kind of arrived in the region and blew everything up.
sentences.zh: 这就是伊朗战争蔓延到该地区并彻底引爆一切的背景。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: In Iran, meanwhile, there had been this faction that was gaining increasing leverage that had been pressing to escalate in the war with the U.S., right?
sentences.zh: 与此同时，在伊朗内部，有一派势力一直在不断扩大影响力，并一直施压要在与美国的战争中升级局势，对吧？

sentences.en: The war has been dragging on for six months.
sentences.zh: 这场战争已经拖了六个月了。

sentences.en: There's no clear end in sight.
sentences.zh: 目前还看不到明确的尽头。

sentences.en: And this sort of group in Iran, group of officials, group of leaders.
sentences.zh: 伊朗内部的这一类群体，由官员组成的群体，由领导层组成的群体。

sentences.en: The hardliners.
sentences.zh: 强硬派。

sentences.en: We talked about them on the show before, yeah.
sentences.zh: 我们之前在节目中讨论过他们，是的。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Wanted to place sort of increasing pressure on Trump via increasing pressure on the global economy, global energy markets.
sentences.zh: 希望通过对全球经济和全球能源市场施加越来越大的压力，来对特朗普施加越来越大的压力。

sentences.en: So at the same time that the Houthis have their own interests that they're pursuing and are feeling increasingly frustrated with the political situation on the ground in Yemen,
sentences.zh: 因此，正当胡塞武装在追求自身利益、对也门当地政治局势感到越来越沮丧的同时，

sentences.en: their backers in Iran have an interest to escalate.
sentences.zh: 他们在伊朗的支持者也有升级局势的利益诉求。

sentences.en: So there's a real kind of collision of mutual interests between the Houthis and their allies and backers in Iran.
sentences.zh: 所以胡塞武装与其在伊朗的盟友和支持者之间，确实存在一种共同利益的碰撞。

sentences.en: And how has that played out on the ground exactly?
sentences.zh: 这在地面上到底是如何上演的呢？

sentences.en: Vivian, just explain that to us.
sentences.zh: 维维安，给我们解释一下这一点。

sentences.en: So it's a complicated story, and there's been a couple of flashpoints where things have really escalated between Saudi Arabia and the Houthis over the past few months.
sentences.zh: 这是一个复杂的故事，过去几个月里，沙特阿拉伯和胡塞武装之间曾发生过几次冲突急剧升级的导火索。

sentences.en: But one of the really key ones was in July when the Houthis declared a naval blockade on Saudi Arabia and essentially said,
sentences.zh: 但其中一个真正关键的事件发生在七月，当时胡塞武装宣布对沙特阿拉伯实施海上封锁，基本上表示，

sentences.en: we're not going to let any Saudi ships through the Red Sea.
sentences.zh: 我们不会让任何沙特船只通过红海。

sentences.en: And after this blockade is launched, you see Saudi Arabia decide to start pushing back, but they seem to be wary of actually entering a full-blown war.
sentences.zh: 在这场封锁发起后，你可以看到沙特阿拉伯开始进行反击，但他们似乎对真正卷入一场全面战争有所顾忌。

sentences.en: So you see airstrikes start happening in Yemen.
sentences.zh: 所以你看到也门开始出现空袭。

sentences.en: The Houthis say Saudi Arabia is bombing Yemen.
sentences.zh: 胡塞武装称沙特阿拉伯在轰炸也门。

sentences.en: Saudi Arabia says nothing.
sentences.zh: 沙特阿拉伯则一言不发。

sentences.en: The Yemeni government claims that it's the ones carrying out those bombings.
sentences.zh: 也门政府声称这些轰炸是他们自己实施的。

sentences.en: And you also see a real escalation in ground fighting between the Houthis and Yemeni fighters who are backed by Saudi Arabia.
sentences.zh: 你还能看到胡塞武装与沙特支持的也门武装人员之间的地面战斗急剧升级。

sentences.en: So things start to heat up on the ground in this kind of period after the blockade.
sentences.zh: 所以在封锁之后的这段时间里，地面局势开始升温。

sentences.en: But for now, nobody seems to want to escalate too much.
sentences.zh: 但目前看来，似乎没有人愿意把局势升级得太厉害。

sentences.en: And that all changes essentially when the Houthis start pushing towards the Red Sea coast last week.
sentences.zh: 然而，当胡塞武装在上周开始向红海海岸推进时，这一切基本上都变了。

sentences.en: And a new wave of Houthi attacks on Saudi Arabia.
sentences.zh: 胡塞武装对沙特阿拉伯发起了新一轮袭击。

sentences.en: The Houthis taking islands in the Red Sea, taking coastline along the Red Sea.
sentences.zh: 胡塞武装占领了红海中的岛屿，占领了红海沿岸。

sentences.en: The Houthis can now threaten almost any shipping passing Yemen's Red Sea coaSt.
sentences.zh: 胡塞武装现在几乎可以威胁到任何经过也门红海海岸的船只。

sentences.en: So the Houthis start assailing these parts of Yemeni territory that are essentially the gateway to the Bab al-Mandab Strait,
sentences.zh: 因此，胡塞武装开始攻击也门领土上的这些地区，这些地区基本上是曼德海峡的门户，

sentences.en: this very important strait at the opening of the Red Sea.
sentences.zh: 这个位于红海入口处非常重要的海峡。

sentences.en: And it's clear that they're pushing and pushing.
sentences.zh: 显而易见，他们一直在不断推进。

sentences.en: But for a time, it seemed like this was going to be a battle.
sentences.zh: 但在一段时间里，这似乎会是一场苦战。

sentences.en: It was going to take a while.
sentences.zh: 这需要花上一段时间。

sentences.en: Saudi Arabia was going to fight back.
sentences.zh: 沙特阿拉伯将会进行反击。

sentences.en: And then suddenly all of that crumbled on Thursday and Friday.
sentences.zh: 然而突然之间，这一切在周四和周五崩溃了。

sentences.en: And government soldiers were retreating incredibly rapidly.
sentences.zh: 政府军以惊人的速度节节败退。

sentences.en: And the Houthis essentially seized this vast swath of territory along the Red Sea that is Yemen's most strategic and important real estate
sentences.zh: 胡塞武装基本上夺取了红海沿岸大片的领土，这是也门最具战略意义和最重要的地盘，

sentences.en: and ended up in control of the Bab al-Mandab Strait.
sentences.zh: 并最终控制了曼德海峡。

sentences.en: And so not just for important for Yemen, but as you said, they basically seized this workaround that Saudi Arabia had that was helping it export its oil since the start of the war.
sentences.zh: 因此，这不仅对也门至关重要，正如你所说，他们基本上夺取了沙特在战争爆发后一直用来帮助出口石油的替代通道。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: So the Houthis were able to launch attacks in the Red Sea from the territory that they previously had.
sentences.zh: 因此，胡塞武装能够从他们先前占领的领土上对红海发动袭击。

sentences.en: But this gives them much more direct control over the strait.
sentences.zh: 但这让他们对该海峡拥有了更直接的控制权。

sentences.en: And then to make matters so much worse, on Friday, the same day that the Houthis have taken over all of this territory that puts them on this key strait,
sentences.zh: 更糟糕的是，就在周五，也就是胡塞武装占领了所有这些将他们置于这一关键海峡的领土的同一天，

sentences.en: Saudi Arabia announces that the crucial cross-land pipeline that it has been relying upon to export oil has been attacked and that they have to shut it down.
sentences.zh: 沙特阿拉伯宣布，其一直依赖的用于出口石油的关键跨陆管道遭到袭击，他们不得不将其关闭。

sentences.en: The East-West pipeline is what goes across Saudi Arabia.
sentences.zh: 东西走向的管道就是横穿沙特阿拉伯的那条。

sentences.en: That was sort of the workaround, OK?
sentences.zh: 那算是一种替代方案，对吧？

sentences.en: If something happens with the straits, we got this, you know, big, wide pipeline.
sentences.zh: 如果海峡出了什么问题，我们还有这个，你知道的，又大又宽的管道。

sentences.en: Well, now it's been hit in multiple points.
sentences.zh: 好吧，现在它在多个地点被击中了。

sentences.en: It's out.
sentences.zh: 它瘫痪了。

sentences.en: The two straits are controlled by Iran and its militants.
sentences.zh: 这两个海峡分别由伊朗及其武装力量控制。

sentences.en: As of now, essentially all of the exits for oil from the Arabian Peninsula have been severely choked off or just cut off.
sentences.zh: 截至目前，阿拉伯半岛的石油出口出口通道基本上已经全部严重受阻或被直接切断。

sentences.en: And all of this has left Saudi Arabia with basically no good options for getting their oil to global markets.
sentences.zh: 所有这一切让沙特阿拉伯在将石油运往全球市场方面基本上没有了好的选择。

sentences.en: And we're already starting to see the impact of that around the world.
sentences.zh: 我们已经开始看到这种影响在世界各地显现。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: I'm Wena Liu.
sentences.zh: 我是韦娜·刘。

sentences.en: I write the game Connections, one of the puzzles from New York Times games.
sentences.zh: 我编写“连线”（Connections）游戏，这是《纽约时报》游戏板块的谜题之一。

sentences.en: And I love horror movies.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢恐怖电影。

sentences.en: I love my dog.
sentences.zh: 我爱我的狗。

sentences.en: And I love trying to trick you.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢试图捉弄你们。

sentences.en: I'm Sam Azersky.
sentences.zh: 我是萨姆·阿泽斯基。

sentences.en: And I create the game Spelling Bee and Letterboxd on a daily basis.
sentences.zh: 我每天都创作拼字蜜蜂（Spelling Bee）和字母宝盒（Letterboxd）游戏。

sentences.en: And I have this thing called promesthesia.
sentences.zh: 我有一种叫做色彩联觉的奇特感知。

sentences.en: I see color when I'm listening to music.
sentences.zh: 我听音乐时能看到颜色。

sentences.en: New York Times games are made by people like the ones you just heard from.
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》的游戏是由刚才你们听到声音的这些人制作的。

sentences.en: Go to nytimes.com slash games to start playing today.
sentences.zh: 访问 nytimes.com slash games 开始今天的游戏。

sentences.en: Vivian, you just told us that Saudi Arabia has no good options to get their oil out of the country.
sentences.zh: 维维安，你刚才告诉我们沙特阿拉伯没有好的选择将石油运出国家。

sentences.en: So what are their bad options?
sentences.zh: 那么他们有什么糟糕的选择呢？

sentences.en: So the first thing to remember is that this is an existential problem for Saudi Arabia.
sentences.zh: 首先要记住的是，这对沙特阿拉伯来说是一个生死存亡的问题。

sentences.en: The entire Saudi economy depends on oil and petrochemicals.
sentences.zh: 整个沙特经济都依赖于石油和石化产品。

sentences.en: Their government budget depends on oil revenue.
sentences.zh: 他们的政府预算依赖于石油收入。

sentences.en: Their payments to royal family members depend on oil revenue.
sentences.zh: 他们对王室成员的供养依赖于石油收入。

sentences.en: So the entire kind of political and economic system of the kingdom is still very much tied up in oil.
sentences.zh: 因此，该王国的整个政治和经济体系在很大程度上仍然与石油息息相关。

sentences.en: They want that to change.
sentences.zh: 他们希望改变这种状况。

sentences.en: But their efforts to diversify away from oil and to turn the kingdom into this tourism and business destination
sentences.zh: 但他们摆脱对石油的依赖、将王国转变为旅游和商业目的地的努力，

sentences.en: also depend on oil revenue because they need to make these investments that are quite costly.
sentences.zh: 同样依赖于石油收入，因为他们需要进行这些相当昂贵的投资。

sentences.en: So if they can't figure out a way to get oil out to global markets, it's a really serious problem for them.
sentences.zh: 因此，如果他们想不出办法将石油运往全球市场，这对他们来说将是一个极其严重的问题。

sentences.en: Okay, so what can they do?
sentences.zh: 好吧，那他们能做什么呢？

sentences.en: So their options are, one is to go back to war with the Houthis and to try to force them to back down militarily.
sentences.zh: 所以他们的选择是，一是重新与胡塞武装开战，试图通过军事手段迫使他们退让。

sentences.en: Which didn't go so well the first time.
sentences.zh: 第一次可没怎么成功。

sentences.en: Yeah, it's a very unattractive course of action for them for a lot of different reasons.
sentences.zh: 是的，出于各种不同的原因，这对他们来说是一个非常没有吸引力的行动方案。

sentences.en: Another option that they could take is to try to come to some sort of diplomatic solution
sentences.zh: 他们可以采取的另一种选择是试图达成某种外交解决方案，

sentences.en: with the Houthis and negotiate an agreement politically that gets the Houthis to back down.
sentences.zh: 与胡塞武装通过政治途径谈判达成一项协议，让胡塞武装做出妥协。

sentences.en: That's also unattractive because everything that their history of negotiations with the Houthis have shown is that this is not a group that is ready to back down easily.
sentences.zh: 这也是没有吸引力的，因为他们与胡塞武装谈判的历史表明，这不是一个准备轻易妥协的组织。

sentences.en: They have very maximalist demands and those demands are only going to get bigger now that they feel in this position of great power and that they have the upper hand.
sentences.zh: 他们有着非常极端的诉求，而且既然他们觉得自己处于强大的地位并占据上风，这些诉求只会变得更高。

sentences.en: So they're definitely considering that option but it's not ideal at all either and there's no guarantee that it leads to a sustainable agreement, right?
sentences.zh: 所以他们肯定在考虑这个选项，但它绝不是理想的选择，而且也不能保证能达成可持续的协议，对吧？

sentences.en: The Houthis could decide in a year or two years actually we want more and it's back to war for you unless you agree to what we want.
sentences.zh: 胡塞武装可能在一两年后突然决定：我们想要更多，除非你们同意我们的要求，否则你们得重新开战。

sentences.en: You know, one player we have not talked about yet is the United States and I bring that up because the United States is both Saudi Arabia's most powerful ally and also the U.S.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，还有一个我们尚未谈到的参与者是美国，我提起这一点是因为美国既是沙特阿拉伯最强大的盟友，而且美国

sentences.en: obviously started this whole war with Iran in the first place alongside Israel.
sentences.zh: 显然最初和以色列一起挑起了这场针对伊朗的战争。

sentences.en: So I wonder, where is the United States in this moment?
sentences.zh: 所以我想知道，在这关键时刻美国在哪里？

sentences.en: Are they helping Saudi Arabia in this moment?
sentences.zh: 他们现在在帮助沙特阿拉伯吗？

sentences.en: Yeah, so because Saudi Arabia is so reluctant to go back to war with the Houthis on its own it is very keen to get support from the United States
sentences.zh: 是的，因为沙特阿拉伯非常不愿独自与胡塞武装重新开战，如果走这条路，它非常渴望得到美国

sentences.en: and other international partners if it takes that path.
sentences.zh: 和其他国际伙伴的支持。

sentences.en: And we do know that Crown Prince Mohammed bin Salman of Saudi Arabia has approached the Trump administration multiple times including as recently as last week
sentences.zh: 我们确实知道，沙特阿拉伯王储穆罕默德·本·萨尔曼曾多次接触特朗普政府，包括就在上周，

sentences.en: to ask the United States to help to ask the United States to kind of join a fight against the Houthis.
sentences.zh: 要求美国提供帮助，要求美国某种程度上加入打击胡塞武装的战斗。

sentences.en: And what did the U.S.
sentences.zh: 那美国

sentences.en: say?
sentences.zh: 怎么说？

sentences.en: As far as we know, President Trump declined.
sentences.zh: 据我们所知，特朗普总统拒绝了。

sentences.en: We do not see any evidence on the ground of, you know, really stepped up U.S.
sentences.zh: 我们在地面上看不到任何迹象表明，美国确实加大了

sentences.en: involvement.
sentences.zh: 介入力度。

sentences.en: There is, of course, some intelligence sharing and other things that were essentially already going on.
sentences.zh: 当然，有一些情报共享和其他基本上已经在进行的事情。

sentences.en: But the U.S.
sentences.zh: 但美国

sentences.en: is not getting involved in airstrikes.
sentences.zh: 并没有参与空袭。

sentences.en: The U.S.
sentences.zh: 美国

sentences.en: seems to have the mindset of let's just leave this to Saudi Arabia to sort out.
sentences.zh: 似乎抱有一种“让沙特阿拉伯自己去解决”的心态。

sentences.en: You know, I can imagine that one reason why the U.S.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，我可以想象美国

sentences.en: might be hesitant to get involved is that the U.S.
sentences.zh: 之所以犹豫不决，其中一个原因可能是美国

sentences.en: is already really overstretched because they are already at war with Iran.
sentences.zh: 已经精疲力竭，因为他们已经在与伊朗交战。

sentences.en: But on the other hand, Saudi Arabia is a really important ally and they are asking for help against a militia that is backed by an enemy of the United States.
sentences.zh: 但另一方面，沙特阿拉伯是一个非常重要的盟友，他们正在请求帮助，以对付一个由美国敌人支持的民兵组织。

sentences.en: So why isn't the U.S.
sentences.zh: 那么为什么美国

sentences.en: willing to step in?
sentences.zh: 不愿介入呢？

sentences.en: Yeah, so Trump has given some statements suggesting that the Houthis don't really want to fight the U.S., that they just want to fight Saudi Arabia.
sentences.zh: 是的，特朗普曾发表一些言论暗示胡塞武装其实不想与美国打仗，他们只想和沙特阿拉伯打仗。

sentences.en: That's a little complicated because Saudi Arabia's oil getting out through the Bab al-Mandab has implications for global energy markets and therefore for the United States.
sentences.zh: 这有点复杂，因为沙特阿拉伯的石油通过曼德海峡运出会对全球能源市场产生影响，进而对美国产生影响。

sentences.en: Sure.
sentences.zh: 确实。

sentences.en: But according to sort of his telling, look, this is a group, we already kind of fought them.
sentences.zh: 但按照他的说法，看吧，这是一个我们已经打过交道的群体。

sentences.en: There was a U.S.
sentences.zh: 去年美国

sentences.en: airstrike campaign against the Houthis last year that was brief and ill-fated.
sentences.zh: 对胡塞武装发起过一次短暂且注定失败的空袭行动。

sentences.en: Essentially, no one has found a military solution to the Houthis.
sentences.zh: 基本上，没有人找到解决胡塞武装的军事方案。

sentences.en: They've gone up against these much wealthier, much more powerful foes.
sentences.zh: 他们曾与这些富有得多、强大得多的敌人交手。

sentences.en: And those much wealthier, much more powerful foes have been forced to back down again and again.
sentences.zh: 而那些富有得多、强大得多的对手却被迫一次又一次地退让。

sentences.en: So Trump doesn't see getting involved in a war against the Houthis as a winning prospect.
sentences.zh: 因此，特朗普并不认为卷入一场针对胡塞武装的战争是有胜算的。

sentences.en: Vivian, I'm so curious, given the fact that you're actually on the ground in Riyadh and have been as all of this has been playing out,
sentences.zh: 维维安，我非常好奇，鉴于你实际上身处利雅得，并且在这一切展开时一直都在那里，

sentences.en: what does all of this pressure actually feel like?
sentences.zh: 所有这些压力实际感觉起来是怎样的？

sentences.en: Like, sort of how is it in the air there?
sentences.zh: 就是说，那里的气氛大致是怎样的？

sentences.en: So it's kind of a weird moment because the Houthis are attacking the kingdom right now, but it's not reaching cities like Riyadh.
sentences.zh: 所以这算是一个奇怪的时刻，因为胡塞武装现在正在攻击这个王国，但它并没有波及到像利雅得这样的城市。

sentences.en: You know, it's mostly affecting cities in the kingdom's south.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，它主要影响的是该王国南部的城市。

sentences.en: So it's weird because everyone knows that we're kind of potentially on the verge of another war.
sentences.zh: 所以感觉很奇怪，因为每个人都知道我们可能正处于另一场战争的边缘。

sentences.en: But at the same time, you know, events are happening, conferences are being held.
sentences.zh: 但与此同时，你知道的，活动照常进行，会议照常举行。

sentences.en: They're talking about tourism events next year.
sentences.zh: 人们还在讨论明年的旅游活动。

sentences.en: There's still kind of an effort to keep going and to sort of maintain the mood that everything's going to be okay, we're going to figure a way out of this.
sentences.zh: 大家依然在努力坚持下去，并试图维持这样一种氛围：一切都会好起来的，我们会找到解决办法的。

sentences.en: And I'm sure they're still working very hard to repair the pipeline and get that back up and running as soon as possible.
sentences.zh: 而且我确信他们仍在非常努力地修复管道，并尽快让其恢复运转。

sentences.en: Is that realistic, though?
sentences.zh: 然而这现实吗？

sentences.en: How fast can one repair a pipeline?
sentences.zh: 修复一条管道到底需要多快？

sentences.en: Well, it's a mystery right now because it depends on how badly it's been damaged.
sentences.zh: 嗯，目前这还是个谜，因为这取决于受损有多严重。

sentences.en: And these are things that only a very small number of people know.
sentences.zh: 而这些是只有极少数人知道的事情。

sentences.en: Probably we've seen some reporting indicating that it could be a matter of weeks.
sentences.zh: 我们可能看到了一些报道指出这可能需要几周时间。

sentences.en: Even that is quite a bad situation for Saudi Arabia.
sentences.zh: 即便如此，对沙特阿拉伯来说也是相当糟糕的境况。

sentences.en: But the worst situation is the fact that no matter how quickly they repair it, as long as there is still conflict in the region and as long as they have foes
sentences.zh: 但最糟糕的情况是，无论他们修复得多快，只要该地区仍然存在冲突，只要他们还有敌人

sentences.en: who are still willing and able to attack the pipeline, that will remain a risk.
sentences.zh: 仍然愿意并且有能力袭击管道，这就将始终是一个风险。

sentences.en: So they could repair it tomorrow and have another attack the next day.
sentences.zh: 所以他们可能明天修好，第二天又遭到袭击。

sentences.en: You know, I'm reminded there was a lot of criticism after the U.S.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，这让我想起，在美国

sentences.en: and Israel went to war with Iran that they should have taken more seriously the idea that Iran would or could shut off the Strait of Hormuz, right?
sentences.zh: 和以色列与伊朗开战后，有很多批评声音认为他们应该更严肃地对待伊朗将要或能够关闭霍尔木兹海峡的想法，对吧？

sentences.en: Like, that was essentially foreseeable.
sentences.zh: 就像，那基本上是可以预见的。

sentences.en: So I guess I just wonder whether it was just as foreseeable that Saudi's oil routes would also be cut off.
sentences.zh: 所以我想我只是在想，沙特的石油运输路线也会被切断，是不是同样可以预见的。

sentences.en: Like, I'm just wondering how predictable this latest iteration of the war was.
sentences.zh: 就像，我只是在想最新一轮的战争有多大可预测性。

sentences.en: I mean, I think if you were a really strategic and smart war gamer, you absolutely could have sat down and gamed this out, you know, months ago.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，我认为如果你是一个真正具战略眼光且聪明的战争推演者，你绝对可以在几个月前就坐下来把这个推演透彻，你知道的。

sentences.en: I think one thing that the Gulf Arab states that are American allies here,
sentences.zh: 我认为这里的美国盟友海湾阿拉伯国家，

sentences.en: Saudi Arabia, Kuwait, United Arab Emirates, these states always realized that they were very vulnerable if Iran were to launch major retaliatory attacks
sentences.zh: 沙特阿拉伯、科威特、阿拉伯联合酋长国，这些国家一直都意识到，如果伊朗对美国发动重大的报复性袭击，

sentences.en: on, you know, United States, that they would be kind of the front lines of that.
sentences.zh: 它们将会非常脆弱，它们会成为这类冲突的前线。

sentences.en: They have these U.S.
sentences.zh: 它们有这些美国的

sentences.en: bases.
sentences.zh: 基地。

sentences.en: They host these U.S.
sentences.zh: 它们驻扎着这些美国的

sentences.en: troops.
sentences.zh: 军队。

sentences.en: You know, they have these American companies that do business there.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，它们有在那里做生意的美国公司。

sentences.en: And their energy, their oil and their gas is so crucial to the world economy that it is really just the most strategic and easiest way for Iran to exert pressure on a country
sentences.zh: 而且它们的能源、石油和天然气对世界经济至关重要，这确实是伊朗对一个远在天边的国家（美国）施加压力的最具战略意义、最简单的方式。

sentences.en: that's very far away, the United States.
sentences.zh: 所以他们一直都知道自己可能会处于这样事情的最前线。

sentences.en: So they've always known that they could potentially be on the front lines of something like this.
sentences.zh: 这也是为什么许多海湾领导人和官员最初试图阻止这场战争发生的部分原因。

sentences.en: And that's part of why a lot of Gulf leaders and officials were trying to prevent this war from happening in the first place.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，维维安，我不禁想起佛罗里达州的那个人，我们在本集节目开头听到的那个加油站老板，他担心高昂的油价

sentences.en: You know, I can't help but think, Vivian, about that man in Florida, the gas station owner that we heard from at the beginning of this episode, who's worried that high gas prices
sentences.zh: 会变得更高。

sentences.en: are going to go even higher.
sentences.zh: 显而易见，这只是这场战争中的一个因素、一个后果，但听起来他和其他人需要为远超我们已经看到的痛苦做好准备。

sentences.en: And obviously that is just one factor, one consequence in this war, but it sounds like he and other people need to prepare for a lot more pain than we've already been seeing.
sentences.zh: 我们还没有看到这场战争的结束。

sentences.en: We haven't seen the end of this war.
sentences.zh: 而且它持续的时间越长，就越是演变成这些新型复杂的结果。

sentences.en: And the longer it's going on, the more it is spiraling into these new kind of complicated consequences.
sentences.zh: 因此，沙特阿拉伯在战争初期有这样一条替代通道，掩盖了战争对油价造成的真实代价。

sentences.en: So Saudi Arabia had this workaround in the early months of the war that had masked the true cost of the war for oil and gas prices.
sentences.zh: 这使得战争的真实代价在石油和天然气价格上被掩盖了。

sentences.en: That is changing now.
sentences.zh: 这种情况现在正在改变。

sentences.en: And we're also seeing kind of a real new kind of snowballing of human suffering that could be happening.
sentences.zh: 而且我们还看到了一种真正意义上的、人类苦难呈滚雪球般加剧的新趋势。

sentences.en: In Yemen alone, the fact that the country is now tilting back into this full-blown war could have devastating consequences for tens of millions of people who were already living
sentences.zh: 仅在也门，该国重回全面战争边缘的事实，就可能给数千万本就生活在其中的人们带来毁灭性的后果

sentences.en: in one of the world's worst humanitarian crises.
sentences.zh: 世界上最严重的人道主义危机之一。

sentences.en: We're seeing kind of all over the globe, all of these consequences spiraling out from this war between the United States and Iran that are having really devastating impacts
sentences.zh: 我们看到在世界各地，美国和伊朗这场战争引发的所有后果都在呈螺旋式蔓延，并正产生真正具有毁灭性的影响

sentences.en: for the economy, for people's ability to afford energy and all of the goods that come from that.
sentences.zh: 对经济、人们承担能源以及由此产生的所有商品费用的能力而言。

sentences.en: What's becoming increasingly clear is that these are not problems that are going to go away quickly.
sentences.zh: 越来越明显的是，这些并非会迅速消失的问题。

sentences.en: These are going to be complicated and they could potentially be long-lasting.
sentences.zh: 这些问题将会很复杂，并且可能持续很长时间。

sentences.en: Vivian Neerheim, thank you so much.
sentences.zh: 薇薇安·尼尔海姆，非常感谢您。

sentences.en: Thank you for having me.
sentences.zh: 谢谢邀请。

sentences.en: As oil prices have surged past $100 a barrel, people around the world have taken to the streets to protest price increases and gas shortages.
sentences.zh: 随着油价飙升突破每桶100美元，世界各地的人们走上街头，抗议价格上涨和天然气短缺。

sentences.en: In France, fishermen clashed with police as they attempted to blockade a fuel depot.
sentences.zh: 在法国，渔民在试图封锁燃料库时与警察发生冲突。

sentences.en: In Portugal,
sentences.zh: 在葡萄牙，

sentences.en: a convoy of frustrated drivers blocked roads to a major oil refinery.
sentences.zh: 一群愤怒的司机组成车队，封锁了通往一家主要炼油厂的道路。

sentences.en: And in Syria,
sentences.zh: 而在叙利亚，

sentences.en: where the government raised fuel prices for a second time in two weeks.
sentences.zh: 该国政府在两周内第二次提高了燃油价格。

sentences.en: Protesters blocked a major highway with flaming tires.
sentences.zh: 抗议者用燃烧的轮胎封锁了一条主要高速公路。

sentences.en: Syrian government officials said they had no choice but to raise prices because of the war.
sentences.zh: 叙利亚政府官员表示，由于战争，他们别无选择，只能提高价格。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: Here's what else you need to know today.
sentences.zh: 以下是你今天需要了解的其他新闻。

sentences.en: The Federal Reserve raised interest rates by a quarter of a percentage point on Wednesday, the first increase in more than three years.
sentences.zh: 美联储周三将基准利率上调了25个基点，这是三年多来的首次加息。

sentences.en: That increase is a major step by the Central Bank's chairman,
sentences.zh: 这次加息是中央银行行长采取的一项重大举措，

sentences.en: Kevin Warsh, to combat inflation, which Warsh has said has been too high for too long.
sentences.zh: 凯文·沃什，旨在打击通货膨胀。沃什曾表示，通胀率过高且持续时间太长。

sentences.en: And
sentences.zh: 而

sentences.en: President Trump on Wednesday threatened retribution against the European Union's invitation to Canada to become a, quote, associate member of the bloc.
sentences.zh: 特朗普总统周三威胁称，如果欧盟邀请加拿大成为该集团的所谓“准会员”，将进行报复。

sentences.en: A move that shows how intent America's traditional allies are on pursuing a more stable future by binding together.
sentences.zh: 此举表明，美国传统盟友通过紧密团结来追求更稳定未来的决心有多么坚定。

sentences.en: If it's a good intention, that's fine.
sentences.zh: 如果这是出于善意，那很好。

sentences.en: If it's a bad intention, we'll put very heavy tariffs on Europe.
sentences.zh: 如果是出于恶意，我们将对欧洲征收非常沉重的关税。

sentences.en: The president said the move could be perceived as a, quote, hostile act.
sentences.zh: 总统表示，此举可能被视为一种所谓的“敌对行为”。

sentences.en: For decades, the Brooklyn Democratic Party operated as a tightly controlled machine until this summer
sentences.zh: 几十年来，布鲁克林民主党一直作为一个受严密控制的机器运作，直到今年夏天

sentences.en: when elections ushered in a bunch of self-described reformers.
sentences.zh: 选举迎来了宪政改革派。

sentences.en: Ever since, the party has been in the grip of a bruising, chaotic, and sometimes thrilling fight.
sentences.zh: 从那以后，该党一直陷入一场残酷、混乱、有时又扣人心弦的权力斗争中。

sentences.zh: 在我和我共同主持的最新一期《都市》节目中，

sentences.zh: 萨拉·凯尼格，讲述了人们试图保持影响力却在过程中失去控制的故事。
